record.title: Merauke closes Sota, Kali Torasi and Bupul crossings to PNG for COVID prevention
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.scope: Three southern Indonesia–PNG crossing points in Merauke district
record.movement: People in either direction, including traditional border crossers.
record.exceptions: By December 2020 nearby PNG residents could shop at Sota twice weekly; relaxation date unknown. By May 2022 market access expanded from three to five weekdays.
record.imposing_authority: Merauke district government; deputy regent signed closure instruction
record.enforcement: Local agency head described deputy-regent order while inspecting Sota; same-paper later reports document exceptions.
record.relationship: Distinct geographic episode from EA018 Skouw–Wutung; unrelated to R5-EA-005 regional-election closure.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; unknown endpoints are not extended to 21 October 2026.
record.official_rationale: Prevent COVID-19 transmission from either country, according to Merauke border-agency head.
record.context: Southern New Guinea crossing group; separate from Skouw–Wutung in northern Papua.
record.uncertainty: Exact first partial reopening and final ordinary-crossing end unknown. Do not treat March 2020–May 2022 as a continuous total closure or copy northern-Papua January onset.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope.
